environment.runtime: isolated Windows Server Core LTSC 2022 container

observations.f4_next: From Hex, F4 opens the chooser. F4 again selects Decode and closes it even after moving the highlight to Text.

observations.empty_pattern_cells: Light stipple. Active field has a cyan background.

observations.query: FF in the Hex field, whole file, forward
observations.during_scan: Small double-bordered processing panel, scan offset and shaded bar in title, blank function slots.
observations.on_escape: Abort alert. Dismissing it restored the starting offset 0.

native_cursor.method: Read GetConsoleCursorInfo while delivering console key events with WriteConsoleInputW

paired_replay.hiewbie_runtime: x86-64 Windows console, GNU-target build run under Windows
paired_replay.alternate_buffer_cursor: The Windows host changed the native height on the primary console. On the alternate buffer it retained its earlier height with VT enabled or disabled. Hiewbie uses an ANSI underline in this case.
open_differences: Byte viewport and edit caret coordinates
